title: GPS
source_docs: UAV Toolbox/UAV Scenario and Sensor Modeling/GPS.md
Sensor Fusion and Tracking Toolbox/Multisensor Positioning/Sensor Models/GPS.md
text: Simulate GPS sensor readings with noise, 2 inputs, 4 outputs; {Reference frame}, {Position input format} sets the position coordinate input, {Reference location} sets the origin of local navigation reference frame, {Horizontal position accuracy}, {Vertical position accuracy}, {Velocity accuracy}, {Decay factor} sets the global position noise decay factor, {Seed} sets the initial seed and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Position
ports.summary: Position of GPS receiver in navigation coordinate system matrix

ports.name: Velocity
ports.summary: Velocity in local navigation coordinate system (m/s) matrix

ports.name: LLA
ports.summary: Position in LLA coordinate system matrix

ports.name: Velocity
ports.summary: Velocity in local navigation coordinate system (m/s) matrix

ports.name: Groundspeed
ports.summary: Magnitude of horizontal velocity in local navigation coordinate system (m/s) vector

ports.name: Course
ports.summary: Direction of horizontal velocity in local navigation coordinate system (°) vector

params.name: Position input format
params.values: Position coordinate input format Local (default) | Geodetic

params.name: Reference location
params.values: Origin of local navigation reference frame [0,0,0] (default) | three-element vector

params.name: Horizontal position accuracy
params.values: Horizontal position accuracy (m) 1.6 (default) | nonnegative real scaler

params.name: Vertical position accuracy
params.values: Vertical position accuracy (m) 3 (default) | nonnegative real scaler

params.name: Decay factor
params.values: Global position noise decay factor 0.999 (default) | scalar in range [0, 1]

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
